changelog:
✨ New Features
• SponsorBlock: Retain SponsorBlock segments for offline music/video playback
• Add Disable auto captions patch
• Add Open system share sheet patch
• Add Remember video quality patch
• Settings: Add "Mark all settings as seen" setting to remove all new setting dots
• Downloads: Native offline downloads support
• Hide layout components: Add "Hide 'Your downloads' shelf" setting
• Add A-B loop patch

🌟 Mod Features
• All Morphe patches for YT Music
• Customizable preset settings
• Extra clone variant with Dynamic Island on supported devices
• In-app update check for new builds

🔧 Bug fixes and other improvements
